latent.definition: pct of ||E_wm(o_i) - E_wm(o_j)||^2 over same-val-episode frame pairs with is_success(s_i, s_j); imagined success = terminal ||z_H - z_g||^2 < tau

pixel.definition: pct of mean(w_j * (clip(D_wm(E_wm(o_i))) - o_j)^2) over ordered same-val-episode frame pairs with is_success(s_i, s_j); w_j = 1 + 20 * (fg AND NOT pusher) from o_j; imagined success = terminal pixel distance < tau_pixel

decision.reason: pixel 13 vs latent 13 successes (needs >= 16): does not join Phase 7
decision.rule: pixel joins Phase 7 as 'post-hoc diagnostic, chosen on val' only with >= 3 more successes than latent; the frozen latent default stays the headline
